summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of the 22 new features on top of the orange app (desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844). 24 of 26 requested checks passed: Navy #0A1931 header (rgb(10,25,49)), orange animated ticker (ticker-scroll) with Same-Day Delivery, italic hero headline 'Build Stronger. Order Smarter.' (computed fontStyle=italic), low-stock-alert listing TMT Bar Fe500 12mm + PPC Cement, locked WA (https://wa.me/916301456725) and Call (tel:+916301456725) float buttons, hamburger with all 9 menu items incl. 6301 badge, Dark Mode toggle (html.dark-mode + localStorage.dark=true, reversible), voice mic button present/clickable, search synonyms (sariya->5 TMT, balu->4 sand, xyz->no-results), 5-star ratings + stock + LOW STOCK badge, Mobile OTP login (alert OTP captured -> verify -> userProfile persisted, auto name 'User 3210'), Forgot/Reset step, Admin PIN 6301 (wrong PIN rejected) with all 5 tabs, Rate Edit persisted to localStorage & reflected on home (₹99), Banner Edit save changed hero headline, Product Add created new card (₹777), CSV export download (as-prices.csv) + CSV import (price 62->55 applied, 'Imported 1 rows'), Settings UPI save (localStorage.customUpi, reflected in cart QR as qa9999@upi) + HTML backup download, full cart flow with UPI QR + order creation + auto wa.me popup, Orders GST bill (blob HTML with GSTIN & GST 18%) + GST WhatsApp share + '+4 Mistri Points earned', Tracker live-map with animated truck emoji, Khata credit + UPI QR panel, Gallery multi-upload (2 imgs) + Camera/Files + ZIP All (as-gallery.html), Loyalty card (Bronze tier), EMI calc (200000/10%/12m = ₹17,583), AI Rate Predictor (18 options, 11 bars, re-renders on select), language switcher (localStorage + category labels), back-btn on all screens. No console errors, no horizontal overflow on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: Login/Logout button is hidden below md breakpoint (class 'hidden md:flex') and the hamburger menu has no Login item, so on a 390px mobile viewport there is NO way to reach the Mobile-OTP login screen or to log out. Verified: login-header-btn visible=False on 390x844.

Language switcher (HI/TE) does not change the hero headline — hero renders heroTxt (bannerText/default EN string) instead of t.b. Requested behaviour 'Language switcher updates hero headline' fails; category labels DO translate correctly.

2 product images fail to load (naturalWidth=0): https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1601055903647-ddf1ee9701b1 (River Sand / M-Sand). Also all Unsplash product photos render as the same generic warehouse-shelf photo, not TMT/cement/sand — visually not representative of the products.

issues: Bars in predict-chart render almost flat/invisible: height is computed from (val-min)/(max-min) so with a narrow price range all bars collapse to a few px, and the value labels + rotate-45 month labels overlap the bar area. Consider a min-height baseline / fixed y-scale.
Chart renders 11 bars (7 'x mo ago' + Now + 3 forecast) instead of the documented 10 (6 past + now + 3) — loop runs i=6..0.
Fixed WA/Call float buttons collapse to icon-only circles and sit over the product grid; acceptable but they overlap the first product row's Add-to-Cart area on scroll.

action_items: Expose Login/Logout on mobile (add a Login/Logout item to the hamburger menu or remove the md-only class on login-header-btn/user-btn)
Make hero headline language-aware: use T[lang].b when no custom bannerText is saved
Replace/fix broken & non-representative Unsplash product image URLs (photo-1601055903647 returns nothing)
Fix predict-chart bar scaling so bars are visibly proportional; align bar count with spec (10) if intended
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1066 lines with 14 screen components in one file — split into /screens and /components for maintainability.

PredictorScreen dereferences p.p at line 1028 (const trend = next.val > p.p) without the null guard used earlier for `history`; if the selected product is deleted in Admin while on this screen it will throw. Also next may be undefined when products is empty.
readFile helper is duplicated in AdminScreen and GalleryScreen — extract a single util (DRY).
Gallery stores full base64 data URLs in localStorage; 100 photos will exceed the ~5MB quota and ls.set only console.errors, silently losing data. Add quota handling/user feedback.
OTP is generated client-side and shown via alert() — acceptable for demo, but any OTP works only against in-memory state (no rate-limit/expiry); flag as mock for production.
Admin PIN '6301' is hardcoded in the client bundle and adminUnlocked resets on reload — no real access control.
seed_data_creation: localStorage-only test data created and left behind in the test browser profile (TEST_QA Product, TEST_Ramesh khata entry, 2 dummy gallery images, custom UPI). No server-side data.
test_credentials: Admin PIN 6301; Mobile OTP login with any 10-digit number (OTP shown in alert)
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% client-side (localStorage, no backend calls) — always run localStorage.clear() + reload before a run, since products/banner/UPI persist across runs. Dialogs (alert) are used for OTP, banner/UPI save, wrong PIN and CSV import — attach an async page.on('dialog') handler. Order confirm, GST WhatsApp and GST PDF open popups — capture with page.on('popup'). Re-verify the 3 reported frontend issues (mobile login access, hero headline i18n, product image URLs, predictor chart scaling).
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile login gap: header login/user buttons use Tailwind 'hidden md:flex' while the hamburger menu (the only mobile nav) lists 9 items with no Login entry. Hero i18n gap: HomeScreen prints heroTxt sourced from getHeadline() (localStorage bannerText || CFG.defaultHeadline) and never falls back to T[lang].b, so lang changes cannot affect it.
